about: Published keys (Beatport / Tunebat / Mixgraph / SongBPM lookups, 2026-10-27/28) for library tracks; the key v2 truth set. 'conflicting' entries are kept for reference but never scored. split: tune = even id (the reader was chosen on these), holdout = odd id (scored once, frozen). ids are THIS machine's (D:/Devel/music); the gate resolves tracks by path. stored_before_v2 = the old reader's camelot.
